steps.name: The Road to the Eastern Continent
steps.objective: Talk to [Durun] at the "Reclamation Army Temporary Camp", then find [Rosemary] at the "Jude Kingdom Eastern Borderlands" on the Eastern Continent.

steps.name: Let's See What You Can Do
steps.objective: Talk to [Rosemary], then travel to the Jude Kingdom Capital and defeat [Desert Fox Tribe Assassins] and [Scorching Genies].

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I haven't seen you before. Who are you? Identify yourself, or else...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please lower your guard. Leo at the Temple of Seres sent me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're Rosemary, right? You came all this way to escort Iris...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: You know quite a bit. Yes, I'm Rosemary...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Wait, you... Judging by your appearance, are you the one Lady Iris mentioned...? First, tell me how you got here. Clearly enough for me to understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, yes. I'm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Rosemary everything that has happened, from the beginning of my journey to the recent events at the Temple of Seres.)

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Unbelievable. You're saying you defeated Blas, the leader of the demon force that attacked the temple? Then Leo sent you here...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: And you did all that purely to meet Lady Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Where is she?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Wait. I can't trust you yet. And I can't simply let you meet Lady Iris.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I'm not so easygoing that I'll trust someone I've just met.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Still, I will help you. But first, you'll have to do a job with me. It may be a little troublesome.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: We reached the East Land with Lady Iris, but something happened. As soon as we arrived, of all times...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: In the center of the East Land is a place called Lumen. Under the name Alliance of Light, it fights the evil that plagues the East Land.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: It's complicated here too. We have more than one enemy to fight. Anyway, their leader, a man named Ziskad who is called the Sword God, has ties to Demigod Frozen.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Lord Frozen decided that, under the Sword God's protection there, Lady Iris could settle more safely into the power she received from Lady Seres.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: They say Lumen has a place where people with unusual gifts can train...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: In any case, we were preparing to head for Lumen. Then, with spectacularly bad timing, someone attacked the Kingdom of Jude and cut off the road.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Lady Iris couldn't stay here, so Frozen took her ahead. I remained behind to assess the situation.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: It's infuriating. I knew this wouldn't be easy, but why does it have to be like this? The beings from the demon realm pursuing Lady Iris are far too much for us to handle alone.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: We've managed to hold out because of Lord Frozen... no, because of that man Frozen...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I've talked too long. If you care about Lady Iris, help me. If Jude falls, Lumen, where she will be staying, will be in danger too.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: First, I need to see what you can do. You know what that means, don't you?

steps.name: Give Me a Hand
steps.objective: Talk to [Rosemary], then travel to the Jude Kingdom Capital and defeat [Mad Sand Spirits] and [Raging Agni Warriors].

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: You're more surprising than you look. I didn't expect you to deal with those enemies so easily. I knew you weren't an ordinary adventurer, but this...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: You pass for now. You seem qualified to protect Lady Iris.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Then let's get to the next task.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Many small tribal villages lie near the Kingdom of Jude. One clan counts the sun god Agni among its ancestors. They call themselves the Agni.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Agni clan?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: They've always lived independently of Jude, working as mercenaries in the desert. As far as I know, their chieftain is even a friend of the King of Jude.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Then one day, he brought his clan to attack Jude. And there's the Kingdom of Moss... Ah, this is complicated. How much do I need to explain...?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Moss was a kingdom in Freios long ago. After a defeat, it ended up in the East Land. I suspect they may be acting at Moss's instigation now.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Anyway, the Agni chieftain led troops into Merta, Jude's capital, and threw it into chaos. Then he disappeared somewhere. We don't know where...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what should we do?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: We've split up to search. Help us.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I don't know where he might be, but we have to find him and face him. What else can we do?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: He's a powerful enemy. He stands at the heart of the Agni fighting mercenaries, so it won't be easy.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I'd like to pursue and fight him myself, but I have to guard this place. Jude's people have fled all the way to this border region, and we're short-handed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are there other enemies besides the Agni clan?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: You know there are plenty of people after Lady Iris, don't you? They're probably demons.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Stay focused. This is a battlefield. If you lose concentration, anything could happen.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Anyway, let's hurry and find him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will it be over once we find the enemy commander?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: We'll have to hope so, won't we?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Sigh. Watching Jude's guards is frustrating. We need to evacuate the civilians, so let's clear out the enemies right in front of us first.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: So much to do. Sigh... I thought becoming a Battle Lord would make things a little easier...

steps.name: Let's End This War Already
steps.objective: Talk to [Rosemary], then find [Hyssop] in the Jude Kingdom Capital.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Good. Very clean work. I can tell you have experience.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: The way you handle enemies is far from ordinary. Phew.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I could trust you with Lady Iris, but there's still much to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now I should go find the enemy commander, right?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Don't rush. What if you charge in blindly and ruin everything? You need information.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: There's a man named Hyssop. He shakes like a coward, but he has information. He may seem incompetent, yet his intelligence network is what has kept him in his position.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Go ask him whether he has information on the enemy commander.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I wonder whether I really have to treat him with respect even now, just because he's captain of the guard. No helping it.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: He'll be blaming himself for failing to defend the capital. Humor him a little, but don't stay too long.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll keep that in mind.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Good...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: If he doubts you, say I sent you. If that doesn't work... tell him I'll spread his secret far and wide. He'll understand. That should get him moving.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: What's with that look? You look as if you're staring at a villain... Yes, I know. It isn't a particularly admirable method...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: But it's a method I had to learn to survive. That isn't what matters right now, so don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I understand.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Go. There's no time. I'll be taking care of other things!

steps.name: The Kaim Chief's Story
steps.objective: Talk to [Hyssop], then defeat [Darman] in the "Sun Palace". Talk to [Darman] afterward, then report to [Hyssop].

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: Your skill at defeating those enemies was exceptional. Who are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please, don't be alarmed. Rosemary sent me. So...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hyssop remains guarded, so I try to persuade him again.)

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: Someone whose allegiance I don't know comes here and invokes Rosemary's name. Of course I have to be cautious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you do doubt me. Rosemary said that Hyssop's secret...

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: ...That's enough. I'll believe you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know what it's about, so you can relax.

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: I accept that you're an ally. You needn't say anything more.

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: Then I'll tell you what I know. First, you should inspect the palace interior.

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: Urgh... You... Who are you? What kind of person possesses such power...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...W-wait... You can speak?

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: L-listen carefully... My soul is mingled with that of an Ancient Ent. I won't be able to hold on for long. It's only your power that has allowed me to awaken now.

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: So I'll tell you what you wish to know. I am Darman, chieftain of the Kaim...

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: We have little time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did you invade the Kingdom of Jude? I don't understand why the Agni clan, which lived peacefully alongside Jude, attacked either, but why did the Kaim...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't understand. Did the Kingdom of Moss put you up to this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth is happening here?

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: It would have been better if we'd attacked Jude of our own free will. At least then we'd have had a cause.

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: But they took the weak, helpless children of our clan hostage and threatened us. They forced us to fight.

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: Every time we refused, they would... our children...

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: They did it because they knew their brainwashing wouldn't work on us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: T-then... what happened to the hostages?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't tell me...

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: They will die. This happened because my virtue and resolve were lacking...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But this... this is too cruel. Surely...

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: It isn't your fault. Don't blame yourself. Those red-haired ones are the cause... They wear human shapes, but they are not human.

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: They brought calamity to the desert, crossed into the East Land, and joined hands with Moss. Moss must have had something it wanted too, to accept them.

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: There is something they mean to gain by starting this war. Stop them. The Agni chieftain was used as well. I'm not asking you to forgive him.

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: Stop them. No more blood must be spilled in the East Land. We already have an enemy common to us all...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the red-haired ones, do you mean Ban and Mara?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please, tell me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And...

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: My mind... is fading. I can no longer hear what you're saying...

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: Before my soul falls asleep... tell Agni... tell the people of Jude... that I was sorry...

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: (Darman's voice can no longer be heard.)

steps.name: Reliable Information
steps.objective: Talk to [Hyssop], then find [Ballas] near the entrance to the "Sun God's Underground Altar".

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: You're back. What is the situation inside the palace?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Hyssop what happened in the palace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Kaim...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Moss and the two who caused all this took Darman's people hostage and threatened them...

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: This is no time for sentiment. Whatever their circumstances, they are our enemies...

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: They attacked us, and we suffered great losses. That is an unchanging fact.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand what you're saying.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's just... that's what happened...

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: You're still dwelling on it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I couldn't find the Agni chieftain there. Do you know where he went? Do you have any information?

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: You're in a hurry. Please calm down for a moment...

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: According to the soldiers, he headed toward the Sun God's underground altar. His Majesty should be there...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. We can't just stand around here.

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: I've already hurried soldiers to Ballas, the palace guard at the underground altar. Please go and investigate.

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: He'll be able to give you detailed information. Wait, you should hear me out before...

steps.name: The Enemy Leader Is…
steps.objective: Talk to [Ballas], then enter the "Sun God's Underground Altar", defeat the [35th Agni], and talk to the [King of Jude].

lines.speaker: 발라스
lines.text: Who are you? Ah, one of Rosemary's companions? The soldiers who arrived earlier told me about you.

lines.speaker: 발라스
lines.text: I'm Ballas, a palace guard. I look forward to working with you.

lines.speaker: 발라스
lines.text: We're preparing to enter, but the interior is complicated, so it may take some time...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're hesitating because it will take time? No, more to the point, how can a palace guard say that...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You couldn't help being ambushed, but this attitude is hardly appropriate now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A retainer who doesn't even know whether the king, the ruler of his country, is alive...

lines.speaker: 발라스
lines.text: ...I have no excuse. This happened because of my weakness. Please blame me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't say that to an outsider like me. It's for His Majesty to judge... I... Sigh. I don't know anymore.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't want to think this way, but why is everyone in Jude like this? I'll go inside and look for the Agni chieftain.)

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: I have nothing to say. Take my head and present it to Jude's army.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How strange. Why have you given up so completely? Almost as if you wanted this to happen...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Darman, chieftain of the Kaim, said he was sorry for attacking.

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: Ah... I see. So that's it. I suspected as much, but still...

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Cough, cough. W-wait a moment. I have something to say to him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty? Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Yes, I am the King of Jude... I'm all right, so don't worry. Forgive me for asking this of someone I've just met, but please step back for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Thank you. You have my gratitude once again...

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: (The King of Jude looks at the fallen Agni chieftain.)

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: It's been a long time, my friend. Your gaze is as cold as ever. Isn't it time you softened a little?

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: You still won't indulge my jokes, and your skill hasn't changed either. It reminds me of the difficult times we faced together long ago.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: With the sun god Agni's power, you were truly extraordinary. Weren't you?

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Hahaha...

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Say something, won't you? I'm the only one talking.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Why did you side with Moss? Why did you attack our kingdom? You were never like this before.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: And why did you leave me alive instead of killing me? From where you stand now, I am your enemy.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: There must be a reason you spared an enemy. Tell me what's happening in the desert. Tell me what has happened.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Only then can I keep my promise to you.

steps.name: Good News 1
steps.objective: Talk to the [King of Jude], then find [Ballas] near the entrance to the "Sun God's Underground Altar".

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: I want to honor my promise to take in your clan when you were in trouble, even now. So please, tell me.

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: All right. I'll tell you. Some people came to Moss. They showed something called magic stones to its king and prince, then brainwashed the soldiers.

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: Moss's soldiers came and oppressed the desert's smaller tribes. In the process, many magic stones were spread around.

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: The tribes and spirits were brainwashed and began attacking. We tried to hold out as long as we could, but there were too many. We were defeated.

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: The Kaim and our clan had no choice but to enter Jude to avoid being killed...

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: I thought I'd established the Agni clan's pride with my own hands, but I destroyed everything... Even the sun god will not forgive me...

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: All because of those red-haired twins, a brother and sister, the continent has become like this...

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: Listen carefully. Moss will keep growing stronger.

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: They'll produce more magic stones and swallow even the East Land!! The Deimos cult may be waiting for just such a moment!!

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Thank you. Leave the rest to me. I'll find a way, whatever happens. Trust me.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Now I'll tell you what will be done with you.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: You'll spend some time in prison, reflecting on your actions.

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: W-what are you saying? You intend to keep me alive? I'm dying. I deserve to die.

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: Otherwise, the people of Jude will never forgive it.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: I won't allow that.

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: If I die, the hostages held by Moss can live.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: ...Do you believe that? Don't. Do you really think King Void and Prince Nox of Moss are men who would show mercy?

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: I'll leave it to you.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Good. You've made the right decision. I'll think of the best way forward.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Now, I've said everything I needed to say. Thank you for giving me time. Let's return and report the situation. The tribes' attack has been brought to an end for now...

steps.name: Good News 2
steps.objective: Talk to [Ballas], then find [Lord Basil] at the "Jude Kingdom Eastern Borderlands".

lines.speaker: 발라스
lines.text: Your Majesty, are you all right? I, Ballas, was concerned for your safety...

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Quiet, quiet. I wondered where you'd gone. How good to see you here.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Are you injured anywhere? Somehow, you look even healthier than before. Haha...

lines.speaker: 발라스
lines.text: M-my safety matters less than Your Majesty's...

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: How many times must I say I'm all right? More importantly, where is Hyssop?

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Surely he hasn't fallen in battle...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. He's coming over there.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: I see. I'll have to speak with Hyssop too.

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: Your Majesty, are you unharmed?

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: I was quite all right a moment ago... but seeing you has made me tired.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: Your Majesty, I have committed an offense deserving death. As captain of the guard, I failed in my duty and could not protect you...

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: I failed to withstand the enemy's attack and fell. All of it was my negligence.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Enough. I understand, so stand up. One more word and I may lose the temper I've been holding back. Enough!

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: (Only after hearing the king's words does Hyssop rise and step back.)

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: You must have learned something from this incident. There is much for you to do now.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Lumen will know what happened to us. The enemy commander has fallen, but stragglers remain, so they'll send people.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: For now, don't rise to the enemy's provocations. Deploy our forces to hold out as best we can. The Alliance of Light will want the same...

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: I'll go with this adventurer to Pesto at the border and work out a plan with Lord Basil. Follow my instructions here.

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: We obey Your Majesty's command!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Can I really trust these people? Sigh... For now, let's escort His Majesty to the border.)

steps.name: Let's Go to Lumen
steps.objective: Talk to [Lord Basil], then talk to [Rosemary].

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: Your Majesty! Your Majesty!!

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Oh! Basil, my friend! Have you been well? It's all the better to see you after so long.

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: You're safe! What a relief! You must have endured so much.

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: I heard an adventurer had gone there to rescue you...

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Yes. I survived thanks to this one. Such astonishing skill. I'd like to use every means at my disposal to keep this adventurer here...

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: But that would be selfish of me. Sigh... What can I do but blame my poor luck with people?

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Judging by the conversations with the church members who came from far away, our friend has other business.

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: Your Majesty...

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: Next time, I'll make sure capable people can serve at your side.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You have a difficult time of it.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Haha, it's all right. If we failed this time, we can do better next time, can't we? Thanks to you, we can protect this country.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: You are this country's benefactor... I will see that your deeds are recorded and praised by future generations.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Just as when the Sword God Ziskad saved everyone long ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I didn't do anything quite that grand...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Now I should finally be able to hear about Iris...)

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Thank you. I hope we meet again under happier circumstances.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: We'll keep looking for better solutions and make sure the people are protected.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Now that Moss has gained new power, I don't expect it to withdraw easily... It will keep using that power to cause trouble.

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: Your Majesty...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll take my leave now. Until next time.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: What a relief. Seeing you back like this... I thought you'd manage without much trouble, but... Anyway, tell me how it all ended.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Rosemary about meeting the Agni chieftain and everything else that happened.)

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Really? Those Agasura joined forces with Moss and used the Kaim and Agni clans?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Something feels strange.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: The Agasura are creating demons and supplying them to the kingdom...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Moss has been struggling for dominance since it was in Freios. After being driven out and coming here, doing the same thing again is understandable enough.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: The problem is those two. The ones who gave Moss the magic stones...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Those Agasura...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I understand they're beings fated to commit evil and sow chaos...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: But their actions feel different. It seems as though they're pursuing some personal matter.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Yes... Don't you feel it?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Sigh. I don't know the details. Anyway, our work here is done...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What exactly are the Agasura...?)

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Now go and pursue your own goal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: You need to go see Lady Iris now, don't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, yes.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Hehe. Your expression finally brightened. Even if I'm not entirely happy about it, there's no helping it. It's our agreement with the church.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I received word that Lady Iris arrived safely in Lumen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah... What a relief.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank goodness, Iris...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It feels as though the weight in my heart is lifting... I...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It won't be long until we can meet now.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Right. I still have work here, so I can't go with you. Head straight to Lumen.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: You can reach Lumen through White Col Canyon, north of the Kingdom of Jude. And...
